notes.text:
Leftovers from the third-pass review of PR #152 (#150, merged), in the files this card edits:
- Three wiki pages went stale on that branch and are stale on main now: `features/up-and-down.md`, `features/hook-install-shapes.md`, `features/operator-seat.md` — re-stamp (`node .repolore/scripts/wiki-stamp.mjs <page>` after verifying the prose).
- src/hook.js ~64-66: the pretool gate calls `whichAttempt` and then re-reads `process.env.KB_TASK/KB_PROFILE/KB_ROOT` instead of using the identity it returned (N3 from #150's review).
- src/model.js ~632 docstring: "or `KB_ROOT` itself for a track root" — no such case; claude-track launches with `--worktree kb-{n}-{k}`.
- src/hook.js ~109 `warnedLeak` is module-level with no reset; test/hook.test.js asserts the single stderr line for the same message in two tests, so they are order-dependent — export a reset or key the dedupe per message+cwd.
- src/model.js ~652 builds `${rootPath}/${worktreePath(…)}` by string concat and compares `path.resolve` results (not realpath): a symlinked hand-set KB_ROOT is judged a leak (safe direction). The resolve boilerplate is duplicated between `whichAttempt` and `checkEnvLeak`.

residual_risk: docs/wiki/features/up-and-down.md and docs/wiki/features/operator-seat.md were flagged stale by the operator's comment (from the #152 review) but are outside this card's declared file scope, so left untouched
hkb doctor's 'if cheap' check on the latest bg attempt's .kanban/sessions/<n>-<k> marker (item 1) was not added -- it's a new check, not a nit fix, and better scoped as its own follow-up card

results.summary: Replaced the stale --bg evidence (FleetView-derived six-source table) with the measured live probe (handleBgFlag -> spawnBgSession, a --settings Stop hook firing seconds after a claude --bg launch) across src/board.js, src/model.js, docs/harnesses.md, docs/wiki/features/hook-install-shapes.md; stopped citing hkb doctor's session-recording line as proof the launch hooks fired (that's since #137's jobSessionUpdate, unrelated to hooks) and named the real Stop-hook trace (.kanban/sessions/<n>-<k> marker). hkbCommandForHook now prefers node "<PKG_ROOT>/bin/hkb.js" whenever PKG_ROOT is durable even with a bare hkb on PATH (bare hkb is now only the npx-cache fallback) -- the hook runs under the session daemon's own PATH (#150), not the launching shell's. decidePermission now returns a kind (policy/capability/path); the PreToolUse denial only appends the --kind capability suggestion for capability denials and no longer double-dots a reason ending in a period (#159). promptingProfiles also recognizes --permission-mode bypassPermissions and --dangerously-skip-permissions. expandLaunch refuses a launch template embedding {hook_settings} inside a larger token instead of silently rendering a bare --settings=. Added the --shared-hooks double-fire residual-risk note to docs/harnesses.md. Also fixed leftovers from the #150 review named in this card's comment (all in files this card already touches): preToolHook reuses whichAttempt's own identity instead of re-reading KB_TASK from env; the leak-dedupe in src/hook.js is now keyed per checkout (not just message text) via a new exported resolvedIdentity helper, which also de-duplicates the resolve boilerplate that used to be copied into src/doctor.js's checkEnvLeak; dropped a stale 'or KB_ROOT itself for a track root' docstring clause in src/model.js.
